info.name: EduPulse API
info.description:
Complete REST API collection for EduPulse LMS.

**Setup:**
1. Set `base_url` to `http://edupulse.localhost/api`
2. Set `tenant_code` to your tenant code (e.g. `acme`)
3. Call **Login** — the token is saved automatically to `auth_token`
4. All other requests inherit Bearer `{{auth_token}}` from collection auth

**Role tokens:** use separate Login calls and copy the token into `manager_token`, `teacher_token`, or `student_token` variables as needed.

request.description: Authenticate and receive a Sanctum token. Token is auto-saved to `auth_token` variable.
Returns the authenticated user's profile and roles.
Revokes the current Sanctum token.

request.description: Returns all 7 dashboard sections in a single cached response (5-min TTL): enrolled_courses, upcoming_sessions, my_weak_topics, recent_quizzes, attendance_summary, pending_fees, unread_notifications.
Returns only courses the authenticated student is enrolled in. Paginated (15/page).
Returns only published lessons (is_published=true) ordered by `order` asc. Returns 403 if student is not enrolled.
Returns all upcoming sessions (status=scheduled, starts_at > now) across enrolled courses. Paginated. Includes jitsi_url for online sessions.
Returns by_status breakdown (present/absent/late/excused), total_sessions, and attendance_rate (%).
Returns published, non-expired announcements filtered to audience=all, audience=grade_level (student's grade), or audience=course (enrolled courses).
Returns own fee records ordered overdue → pending → waived → paid. Includes feeStructure and course relations.
Returns paginated notifications + live unread_count. Accessible to any authenticated role.
Lightweight endpoint for mobile badge polling. Returns { unread_count: N }.
Marks a single notification as read and returns the updated record with read_at set.
Bulk operation — marks all unread notifications as read in a single call.
Send a question with optional lesson_id for context-aware AI response. Pass session_id on follow-up messages to maintain conversation history (last 10 messages). Returns reply + session_id.
Follow-up message in an existing session. AI uses last 10 messages as context.
Generate a progressive quiz at level 1, 2, or 3. Returns structured question set calibrated to the difficulty level.

Auto-corrects answers, records QuizAttempt, updates WeakTopic profile. Returns score, per-question results with explanations, and next_level (null if failed or at level 3). Dispatches score_alert n8n webhook if score < 50%.
